headline: AI Time Tracker Observes Your Computer To Log Activity Automatically
summary: Forget manual timers and spreadsheets. This new AI tool monitors your computer to log your time, classifying activities and even using vision analysis for context.
details: Tired of manually tracking your time? A new AI-powered Windows application, Time Tracker AI 2.0, aims to solve this by automatically observing your computer activity.

The tool logs your time without any manual input, identifying applications, websites, and classifying tasks. It builds a timeline, calculates productivity metrics, and alerts you if your actions deviate from your plans.

It continuously monitors your active Windows application, window title, and activity duration in the background. It detects idle periods without recording keystrokes and merges consecutive observations into useful activity records.

Time Tracker AI tracks browser activity by attributing it to individual websites, supporting major browsers like Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. It sanitizes URLs to remove query parameters and fragments, providing context beyond just the application name.

The application uses a rule-based classification pipeline, with optional AI-assisted classification via the Gemma model family for more ambiguous activities. Users can create custom categories and rules to refine classification.

For enhanced context, an optional vision-analysis path analyzes screenshots of ambiguous windows when an Ollama vision service is available. A sensitive-application blacklist prevents processing of screenshots from banking or password manager windows.

headline_marked: Apple's [[overhauled MacBook Pro]] may finally offer 5G
headline: Apple's overhauled MacBook Pro may finally offer 5G
summary: The first major MacBook Pro redesign since 2021 is expected to feature OLED and touch support, with 5G connectivity now a strong possibility.
details: Apple is gearing up for a significant update to its MacBook Pro lineup, marking the first major overhaul since 2021. The new models are anticipated to introduce a range of advanced features, including OLED displays and touch functionality.

A key rumored addition to the upcoming MacBook Pro is 5G cellular support. This would bring enhanced connectivity options to the laptop, allowing users to stay connected on the go without relying on Wi-Fi or cellular hotspots.

The redesign is expected to bring a fresh aesthetic and improved user experience to the MacBook Pro. While specific details about the OLED screen technology and touch integration are scarce, the move signals Apple's commitment to innovation in its premium laptop line.

This potential integration of 5G technology in the MacBook Pro would align with the growing trend of cellular connectivity in portable devices, offering greater flexibility and productivity for users who require constant internet access.
